description: 5 fighter: ARMHAWK patrolling a lane towards a distant enemy Valkyrie transport — Activate at takeoff, the banking flight, and the first air-to-air shots (QueryPrimary/QuerySecondary per missile; a Hawk has no Aim* script). Kept short on purpose: an air-to-air engagement faults the engine in ORDERS_CreateObject (0x43A164, a null unit's position) within a few seconds of the first shot, with and without the oracle armed (2026-09-07), so the pose dump is taken in flight before the shooting and the run is kept short; the shipped fixture happened not to fault. The target is unarmed and tough so nothing dies in the run: with a Vamp, either aircraft's death faulted the engine in ORDERS_CreateObject (0x43A164, a null target's position) with and without the oracle armed (2026-09-07). Both fly patrols, not attack orders: an `attack` on a unit that then dies faulted the engine in ORDERS_CreateObject (0x43A164, a null target's position) with and without the oracle armed (2026-09-07). tacob landing 2 fixture (research/notes/tacob-design.md, the nine gate scenarios). One unit of the class under test, owned by the human seat, traced with tagpu_cobtrace.on=<type> and one posedump; the AI seat holds a distant unit so the mission does not end. Run all nine with tools/cobtrace_fixtures.py.
